taskDescription: Arrange the six links of the chain of HAI transmission in the correct order, from the origin of the infectious agent to the susceptible host.
paragraphs: Infectious agent — the pathogen causing infection (e.g., MRSA, carbapenem-resistant Acinetobacter)
Reservoir — where the agent survives (colonised patient, HCW hands, contaminated equipment)
Portal of exit — how the agent leaves the reservoir (respiratory secretions, blood, urine, wound exudate)
Mode of transmission — how the agent reaches a new host (contact, droplet, or airborne spread)
Portal of entry — how the agent enters the new host (surgical wound, catheter site, respiratory tract)
Susceptible host — the patient vulnerable to infection (immunocompromised, post-surgical, ICU patient)
